newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DELY VALDES TAKES PARIS ST GERMAIN BACK TO THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DELY VALDES TAKES PARIS ST GERMAIN BACK TO THE TOP.

text.p: Two goals from Panama striker Julio Cesar Dely Valdes helped Paris St Germain clinch a fine 3-0 home win over Bastia and regain the lead in the French first division on Sunday.
Victory restored PSG's three-point lead 24 hours after Monaco had taken top spot on goal difference by beating Bordeaux 3-1.
Title holders Auxerre are third, a further point behind. They won 2-0 at Le Havre.
PSG, who routed Galatasaray in the European Cup Winners' Cup on Thursday, went ahead through Patrice Loko in the eighth minute.
Dely Valdes, who -- like Loko -- scored in the 4-0 second round second leg win over Galatasaray, missed two chances before the interval.
But he confounded his critics with goals in the 71st and 81st minutes.
PSG face lowly Nice away on Wednesday. Monaco visit struggling Marseille on Tuesday.
